title: llm-rosetta extension manifest (plugin.yaml)
description: What one extension folder declares beside its code: who it is, which core it needs, and which shims and transports it provides.

id.description: The extension id: the vendor key its shims are named after and the name it is imported under (llm_rosetta_ext.<id>). Globally unique across extension repositories and core built-ins.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional pre-release (-rc.1), no build metadata. Must equal the version in the extension's pyproject.toml.

requires.description: Compatibility: 'surface' must equal the core's contracts.SURFACE_VERSION, and 'ir' must not exceed its contracts.IR_VERSION. 'extensions' lists other extensions whose transports this one names; the installer installs them too.

provides.description: What the extension registers. At least one of 'shims' and 'transports' is not empty.

shims.description: Shim names: the id itself, '<id>--<name>', or '<id>_<lane>--<name>'.

transports.description: Transport ids this extension implements, private to it unless another extension requires it.

external.description: Programs the extension drives and does not ship.

check.description: The command that reports the program's version.

summary.description: One-line description per language; 'en' is required.
